ui_state.title: The Chartist Position Sizing Equation
ui_state.expression: Position Size = (Account Capital * Risk %) / |Entry Price - Stop Loss Price|

variables.label: Account Equity
variables.description: Total liquid capital available in your trading account.

variables.label: Risk Percentage
variables.description: Maximum capital risked per trade (strictly 1% to 2% under Murphy's rules).

variables.label: Price Risk (Stop Distance)
variables.description: The point distance between your entry price and technical invalidation level.

variables.label: Profit Target Ratio
variables.description: Minimum 3.0 ratio required: prospective profit must be at least 3x the price risk.

ui_state.question: A novice trader bought shares of a tech company after reading record quarterly earnings headlines. However, the stock was trading directly into a major multi-year weekly resistance level with heavy bearish RSI divergence, and collapsed 25% over the next two weeks. Which foundational John Murphy principle explains this devastating trap?
options: A) Market makers illegally altered the company's financial statements.
B) Market action discounts all fundamentals in advance; smart money used the good news liquidity to distribute into major resistance.
C) Technical analysis only works on stocks that report net losses.
D) The stop loss was placed too close to the prevailing spot price.

ui_state.heading: THE 8 CHARTIST COMMANDMENTS
steps: 1. Market action discounts everything: never argue with prevailing price action.
2. Prices move in trends: trade exclusively in the direction of the dominant primary trend.
3. History repeats itself: chart patterns reflect unchanging human crowd psychology.
4. Demand volume confirmation: trading volume must definitively expand in the trend direction.
5. Respect polarity: broken support becomes future resistance, and resistance becomes support.
6. Always use a stop loss: ruthlessly cap loss at 1% to 2% of total capital per trade.
7. Enforce a 1:3 reward-to-risk ratio: never risk capital unless prospective gain is 3x.
8. Consult higher timeframes first: the weekly primary ocean tide overrules daily ripples.
